name: Deathmarks
equipped_with: Every model is equipped with: Synaptic disintegrator.
abilities: Aetheric Interception: When an enemy unit is deployed from reserves, a Deathmarks unit in reserve may immediately deploy within 18" of that enemy unit, but no closer than 9", without requiring a successful 4+ roll in the preceding Reinforcement phase. The Deathmarks may then fire at that unit as if they had been given the "Stand & Shoot" order. This attack resolves after the enemy unit has been deployed but before it takes any further actions.
